text:
incident-bot: SEV-2 detected: metering pipeline anomaly — token counts drifting negative vs source (delta > 15%) and delayed emits across kafka-partition-12. Auto-page sent to #incidents and oncall.

jordan-oncall: acked. paging in SRE + metering owners. tagging @caroline-metering and @ben-sre.

ben-sre: looking. initial quick check: emitter consumer lag jumped ~18k msgs, offsets stalled at 245,678. suspect consumer OOM on worker-3.

caroline-metering: we see delayed usage events in the viz pipeline, ingestion timestamps ~30-90m behind; some windowing caused overage-flags to fire for customers with bursty traffic.

lisa-cs: hey — any immediate customer impact? we already have 3 inbound tickets complaining about unexpected overage emails.

jordan-oncall: Customer impact = potential false overage alerts + delayed billing reports. Priority: suppress false overage notifications and surface ETA.

ben-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause overage alert rule for windows impacted (temporary suppression) 2) restart emitter consumer on worker-3 with increased heap 3) kick manual backfill for lagged partitions 4) monitor token delta.

caroline-metering: agreed. I'll run the suppression now. doing: ```curl -XPOST https://ops/api/alerts/suppress -d '{"rule":"overage-window-v2","until":"2026-03-17T15:30Z"}'```

devops-bot: Action logged by caroline-metering: alert suppression applied (id suppr-602).

ben-sre: restarting consumer -> `kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-consumer -n metering --field-selector spec.nodeName=worker-3`

ben-sre: consumer restarted, logs show GC spikes. bumping Xmx from 6g -> 10g and re-rolling.

sam-ml: quick check: quantization service not involved. model-serving unaffected. this is strictly metering ingest.

caroline-metering: initiating backfill for partitions [11,12,13]. running job: `metering-backfill --since=2026-03-17T12:00Z --to=now --partitions=11,12,13`

jordan-oncall: ETA for backfill completion? need time for CS message.

caroline-metering: rough estimate 90-120 minutes for catch-up, depending on throughput. if consumer stability holds, should be closer to 90.

lisa-cs: I'll post a proactive note to affected customers: short blurb explaining delayed usage reports and that billing adjustments will be applied if needed. ping me with final ETA.

ben-sre: monitoring token-delta metric now: delta trending back from 18% to ~6% after restart and suppression.

devops-bot: Metric alert cleared: metering.consumer-lag > 10k resolved.

jordan-oncall: good. assign follow-ups: caroline = backfill & reconciliation, ben = root-cause triage (OOM cause & pod sizing), lisa = customer comms & ticket triage, sam = verify no ML model billing effects.

caroline-metering: creating incident runbook and will link postmortem draft. ticket for reconciliation created: MTR-7891.

ben-sre: adding heap dump artifacts to MTR-7891 and scheduling deeper analysis — suspect memory leak introduced in 2026-03-15 emitter patch.

lisa-cs: outbound note queued, waiting for final ETA. will include: apology, timeline, and statement that we will credit any erroneous overage charges.

jordan-oncall: handoff plan: if backfill not complete by 18:00Z, escalate to eng-leads and open formal SEV-1. Current status: mitigation applied, customers notified pending final ETA.

caroline-metering: backfill job at 48% complete, token-delta down to 2.1%. will update in 20m or on completion.

ben-sre: root-cause triage started. leaving channel for now to prepare dump analysis.

jordan-oncall: thanks everyone. keep updates short here. postmortem will be required; set owner to caroline. closing active page if no regression in next hour.

caroline-metering: backfill complete at 1768457402. reconciliation job reports corrected token counts and suppressed false overage events. closing mitigation steps and starting postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MTR-7891

lisa-cs: sending final customer note now. will follow up with billing credits where applicable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (SEV-2 -> mitigated). Logs and timeline preserved in channel.

jordan-oncall: resolved. filing post-incident checklist and will schedule blameless postmortem review tomorrow.
